issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: polished_andesite, stone_brick_slab, smooth_stone_slab, andesite_wall, chiseled_stone_bricks, oxeye_daisy, azure_bluet, stonecutter, dandelion, cornflower, fern, stone_brick_wall, polished_andesite_stairs, moss_carpet, gray_wall_banner, stone_button.
Plant with no dirt or grass under it (can't be placed in game; use a flower pot, or dirt under it) at (9, 1, 4), (8, 1, 6).
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Statue in progress inside its scaffold, banner, potted plant and flowers on top of L2's stand and stonecutter.
notes.purpose: Statue under scaffolding makes it unmistakably a mason's yard.
notes.roof: Eaves overhang the long sides (warning partly a false alarm); gables flush and untrimmed.
notes.life: Bushes, flowers at the shed's foot, moss, a potted plant: good.
notes.depth: Bushes soften the long side wall, but the wall itself is still flat.

visual.summary: L2 plus a statue being carved inside a scaffold in the yard corner, a banner, bushes, flowers and moss round the shed; the most lived-in level.
problems: Gables have no overhang or trim (all levels): extend the roof past each gable or add verge trim.
Long side wall of the shed is still a flat stone face behind the bushes: one post or beam would fix it.
Reachability fine: roof slopes, ridge, an interior trapdoor top, an oak_leaves top at (0,2,9) and a few wall-top spots unreached; floor and yard all reached.
